shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations (§73, user-verified), and a subsystem-health panel. LIVE on Workshop 3776015553. Owed: Workshop smoke test, §62.N/§70 field verifies, upstream paste; §73 ships with the next publish.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-SEVEN RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH; the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.** 38 (§73): **WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, THERE MAY BE NO DRAW CALL THERE TO PATCH - camera culling means an off-screen pawn is never drawn at all. Own the draw: run all three DynamicDrawPhases at the target loc, veto the atlas blit, and key every phase off ACTUAL state (stagger durations are stat-scaled and advisory).**

**Picks (user-locked, mockup defaults):** STAIRS B "Tread steps" (grand stairs share it), LADDER C "Peek and drop", ELEVATOR B "Freight lift". Elevator = pawn-only v1 (car-plate sprite offer stands). Mockups remain in `mockups/` (A/B/C selectors per type; never ship; strip move 5).

**Field test (run #305) passed:** §297 regression (cross-level orders complete, drafted + undrafted), ghost clips visible at the origin mouth, clean destination view during ghost then emerge, per-type clips read correctly both directions, elevator clank/bounce/dust, counters advancing, zoomed-out survival (cache veto), no stagger stragglers, zero errors captured. Ghost-window mismatch produced no field complaints; hostile-skip fallback stays pocketed.

**Architecture (all in `Source/V2/ABStairAnim.cs`, class name kept):** carry untouched; both pather teleport sites call `NotifyTransited(pawn, t.near, t.far, prePos, landing)` as pure observers; post-hop hold = `StaggerFor(entry+hold, 0f)` (elevator board+travel) with the Sweep cutting to emerge the moment the pawn leaves its landing cell (stagger is stat-scaled + refusable - clips key off ACTUAL state, rule 38); ghost pass `DrawGhosts` from the `DrawDynamicThings` postfix runs the pawn's THREE DynamicDrawPhases at the origin mouth (`ghostArmedId` + `ABBelowRenderCache.BeginPawn/EndPawn` bracketing; never DrawNowAt - stale-pose lesson); hide-at-landing = 0.002 matrix dot (scale IS the hide mechanism, cache veto guarantees the matrix is honored); see-below pass skips ghosting pawns (no double image through the opening); pawn label suppressed while ghosting. Pose plumbing: `TryGetPose → ClipPose{offX,offZ,rot,sx,sz,hide}` consumed by the ONE `GetDrawParms` postfix, right-multiplied TRS composing with the depth cue; `ScaleFor`/`ShimmyFor` gone; `IsAnimating` kept for both cache-veto sites; threading discipline preserved (count guard, tick-only writes). `ReadyToCarry` DELETED - the run #297 lesson lives in the banner and rule 38.

**Clip content:** STAIRS entry 26t = 5 stepped treads along `glideDir` (approach-derived, Rotation fallback) + hop + alternating lean, 1→0.32 down / 1→1.14 up, `Vanish` final shrink standing in for a fade; hold 6t (nobody drawn); emerge 26t = 4 treads sliding from the FAR ANCHOR to the landing (covers stepped-aside landings), from-above 1.14→1 behind a fast `reveal` ramp, from-below 0.32→1 + settle bump. LADDER 40/8/30: peek beat (lean, first 15%) then TWO big pulls (±0.09 rock, ±7° lean); emerge = head-pop from 0.18 with overshoot then two pulls (from below) / two drops + hop off (from above). ELEVATOR board 8t (weight dip + clank puff at notify) + sink half of 10t/level travel (shake jitter), emerge = rise half + bounce (sx 1.10/sz 0.88 + dip) with the landing puff thrown from the Sweep at q=0.86.

**Counters (rule 15):** `transit clips: started / ghost draws / anim frames / cache vetoes / live` in `CountersLine()` (transit-health report). **Settings:** `transitAnim` default ON (visuals section; OFF = old instant hop, no clip, no stagger). **Lore banked:** ghost-draw pattern (user `animation`), StaggerFor advisory duration (user `pawns`).

**⚠ Known accepted mismatch (rule 26 exception, ledger 16):** during the ghost window the pawn is logically at the destination (hittable, turret-targetable) while its sprite is at the origin mouth; selection brackets still draw at the landing (only the label hides). Field-observed as unobjectionable; revisit only on a real report.
